items.title: KKR, Singtel and Tata Communications explore sale of STT GDC India at over $5.5 billion
items.subject: Singtel
items.why: KKR is preparing to sell Singtel in India or ANZ ($5.5 billion): sell-side tech VDD gets scoped before banks are picked.
items.call: Call the KKR portfolio team this week and pitch the sell-side tech VDD.

items.title: Cleanaway stock faces AUD 9.3 billion EQT takeover
items.subject: Cleanaway
items.why: EQT has agreed to buy Cleanaway in India or ANZ (AUD 9.3 billion): buy-side DD is done and the post-close tech agenda is open.
items.call: Pitch the EQT deal team the 100-day tech plan, an AI-readiness review and, if a carve-out, the separation work.

items.title: TPG, GIC-backed Asia Healthcare lifts commitment to hospital chain AINU
items.subject: AINU
items.why: A reported move by TPG in Southeast Asia: not yet an event, but worth a watch.
items.call: Watch; no call yet. Re-read when the next report lands.

items.title: KKR, Singtel, Tata plan to sell data centre company; seek at least $5 billion in sale: Report
